messages:
support_ana: Hi team — ACME (tenant acme-corp) opened a ticket: p95/p99 lines disappeared from their tenant latency dashboard after last night's deploy. Ticket: https://acme.support/INC-4821 :frowning:
customer_acme_ops: Confirmed, we lost the p95/p99 curves on the tenant view around 22:40 UTC. Other panels (throughput, errors) look normal. Screenshot: https://img.acme/shot.png
support_ana: Thanks — can you paste the tenant id and a link to the exact dashboard panel? Also whether org-level view shows the lines.
customer_acme_ops: tenant id acme-corp, panel link https://console.redwood/tenants/acme-corp/dash/latency. Org-wide view still shows p95/p99 for the same time range.
support_ana: Pinging eng oncall and SRE for triage — @eng_oncall_jordan @eng_sre_irene :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary rollout completed: edge-proxy v2.14.1 -> 2024-11-10T22:37:12Z, telemetry-transform FF=on in canary, commit 9af3c2d
eng_oncall_jordan: I can repro on prod tenant view — panels for p95/p99 render empty series (legend shows nothing). Org view has the traces. My quick guess: label mismatch or transform dropped tenant label in canary.
eng_sre_irene: digging in metrics collector logs and series metadata. Initial check: p95/p99 series exist but labels changed. Running a raw series query now:
```
fetch_series("latency_ms", from=2024-11-10T22:30Z, to=2024-11-10T23:10Z, tenant="acme-corp")
```
eng_sre_irene: Results: collector emitted quantiles under metric name latency_ms_v2 with label owner=acme-corp instead of tenant=acme-corp. Tenant-specific dashboard panels filter by tenant label -> no matching series.
metrics-bot: logs excerpt: `telemetry-forwarder: applied transform 'strip_tenant_label' (flag=true) — renamed labels: tenant->owner, metric_name->latency_ms_v2`
eng_oncall_jordan: That matches. Looks like a telemetry transform was toggled in canary and rolled to some edge proxies. Workaround: dashboard panel query can be edited to match owner label or use org-level dashboard until we revert. Example override:
```
SELECT quantile(0.95, latency_ms_v2) BY owner FROM metrics WHERE owner='acme-corp'
```
eng_sre_irene: Short-term fix: rolling back the transform flag on the canary hosts now. I'll disable the telemetry-transform FF and restart the forwarder on the affected fleet. ETA ~15m.
support_ana: I'll relay the workaround and ETA to the customer.
customer_acme_ops: Thanks, appreciate the ETA. We rely on those percentiles for SLO checks :pray:
eng_sre_irene: Rollback done at 22:58 UTC, restarting forwarder. Watching ingestion.
metrics-bot: ingestion events: series latency_ms restored with tenant=acme-corp at 23:02:11 UTC
eng_oncall_jordan: Confirmed — tenant panels show p95/p99 back at ~23:02. I can see curves repopulating on the acme-corp dashboard.
customer_acme_ops: We see it too, p95/p99 are back. Thanks.
eng_sre_irene: Root cause: telemetry transform (label rename + metric name change) was accidentally enabled in the canary rollout. It removed the tenant label key dashboards relied on. Next steps: revert transform permanently until we ship a dashboard migration, add unit tests to detect label renames, and add a canary validation check that tenant-scoped dashboards still render.
eng_oncall_jordan: Filing follow-up ticket for metrics team to add dashboard regression test and for product to coordinate any label changes.
support_ana: Closing the support escalation for now — customer confirmed recovery. Will update ticket INC-4821 with timeline and workaround. :white_check_mark: 
eng_sre_irene: Posting runbook update now and adding a quick rollback playbook to handle telemetry flag flips.
customer_acme_ops: Thanks everyone, great response time. :thumbsup:
